integrity: The proof is analytic and uses the published constant-modulus theorem plus equality in the generic-fiber Cauchy--Schwarz step. Finite modular computations are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to prime fields of characteristic greater than three; no complete extension-field maximizer classification is claimed. Differently indexed older literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Prime-field maximizers for the sharp finite-field parabola extension inequality
